points.description: States that cleaning is done by scraping (cutting off/removing) the top layer of the filter medium/sand, including the Schmutzdecke (dirty surface layer), typically the upper 1–2 cm.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says removing/cleaning the top layer or surface without scraping, or scraping without mention of the top/surface layer.

points.description: States that the scraped medium/sand is then washed (before reuse/replacement).
points.partial_credit: Half if washing is mentioned vaguely (e.g. 'cleaned') without clearly applying to the removed sand.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for saying the top layer of the sand (Schmutzdecke, about 1–2 cm) is scraped off and then washed. Give 1 mark if only scraping or only washing is given, or both are stated vaguely. Give 0 for wrong methods such as backwashing alone, chemical dosing or rapid-filter cleaning. Depth figure and the word Schmutzdecke are not strictly required.
